name: DB Migrate

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  db-migrate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Deploy
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          echo "Deploying..."
